title: dacs-verifier verify request
description: Body of POST /verify and arguments of the MCP verify_bundle tool.

bundle.description: A DACS AttestationBundle: v0.1 (bundleVersion "1") or legacy (v "dacs-5-bundle:0.1").

offline.description: Compatibility echo of the MCP server policy, or a request option on unlocked HTTP/CLI surfaces. It cannot weaken the MCP server policy.

requireSignatures.description: Compatibility echo of the MCP server policy, or a request option on unlocked HTTP/CLI surfaces. MCP fixture mode must be authorized by server configuration.
